issue.title: Disk-space alerts never leave the box: Alertmanager is inactive with sample receivers

task_type_fields.impact:
## Impact

Defeats the stated purpose of epic bob-cli-15's guardrails phase: "monitoring alerts
before either filesystem fills again". Today the alerts are only visible to someone who
opens the Prometheus UI. `/mnt/hercules` reaching 100% used — the incident that motivated
the epic — would fire an alert that nobody receives.

Proposed by bob-cli-15.7 as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP:` note; filed by the bob-cli-15 land agent.
task_type_fields.repro:
## Repro

```bash
systemctl is-active prometheus-alertmanager            # -> inactive
grep -A3 receivers /etc/prometheus/alertmanager.yml    # -> shipped sample receivers
curl -s http://localhost:9090/api/v1/alerts            # -> AthenaHercules* alerts present
```

`prometheus.yml` already points at `localhost:9093`, and the five `athena.disk-space`
rules added by epic bob-cli-15.7 evaluate correctly (`AthenaHerculesDiskSpaceWarning`
and `AthenaHerculesDiskSpaceCritical` were both pending at 95.24% used when checked on
2026-08-26), but there is no running Alertmanager and no real receiver, so nothing is
delivered.

The box already has a working outbound mail path (Postfix delivers cron output, and
`/etc/anacrontab` sets `MAILTO=bryanbugyi34@gmail.com`), so an email receiver is the
obvious candidate — but picking the notification path is the project owner's call.
